questions.prompt: For each indicator independently, classify the supplied record as supported, counterevidence or unknown. Several indicators may be supported together. Distinguish current and earlier facts, reported statements and verified events. These classifications concern evidence in this authored record; any forced-labour or trafficking conclusion requires its own elements and applicable scope.

options.label: Abuse of vulnerability
options.description: Use of a person's constrained alternatives or dependence to obtain or retain labour.

options.label: Deception
options.description: Materially misleading recruitment or work promises supported by the record.

options.label: Restriction of movement
options.description: Constraints on leaving or moving freely, distinguished from proportionate safety arrangements.

options.label: Isolation
options.description: Prevented or substantially restricted outside communication or contact.

options.label: Physical or sexual violence
options.description: Reported physical or sexual violence connected with obtaining or retaining work.

options.label: Intimidation or threats
options.description: Threatened adverse consequences that pressure work, compliance or silence.

options.label: Retention of identity documents
options.description: Withholding identity or travel documents so that the person lacks free access.

options.label: Withholding of wages
options.description: Withholding or coercive control of earnings, including control after a deposit.

options.label: Debt bondage
options.description: An asserted debt or manipulated repayment arrangement used to bind continued labour.

options.label: Abusive working or living conditions
options.description: Working or living conditions that indicate serious abuse, with context and verification limits stated.

options.label: Excessive overtime
options.description: Excessive hours or denied rest combined with pressure or penalties that undermine genuine refusal.

questions.prompt: Which information need would be most useful to clarify next, considering the user's request and available facts? This preference remains unscored; explain your reasoning in a free-answer run when requested.

options.label: Exit and document access
options.description: Clarify the practical ability to end work and access original identity or travel documents.

options.label: Control of earnings
options.description: Clarify who can use earned money and what has actually been retained or transferred.

options.label: Costs and proper payer
options.description: Clarify itemized costs, overlapping payments and which party should bear each expense under applicable rules.

options.label: Consent and alternatives
options.description: Clarify what happens after an actual refusal and which options the worker can freely choose.

options.label: Hours and rest
options.description: Clarify hours, recovery rest, payment and any consequence for refusing additional work.

options.label: Safe contact and privacy
options.description: Clarify the person's preferred safe channel and permission before involving another party.
